basics.name: Diego Zamboni
basics.label: CISO • Security and Organizational Leader
basics.summary: Security executive and organizational leader with 30 years of experience building and leading security programs, teams and governance capabilities across financial services, cloud platforms and enterprise technology organizations. I work effectively with boards, executives, business stakeholders and engineering teams to translate risk into clear priorities, establish durable controls and deliver measurable security outcomes.

work.name: Avaloq
work.summary: Lead Avaloq's global CISO Governance team and define, operate and monitor the company's Information Security Management System.
highlights: Own governance direction for security policies, requirements and compliance oversight.
Define and monitor Avaloq's global ISMS and related control framework.
Provide effective second-line oversight of first-line security functions in a regulated fintech environment.

work.name: Amazon Web Services
work.position: Global Security Architect / Senior Global Security Architect
work.summary: Led security architecture engagements with global AWS customers, aligning business objectives and engineering execution with enterprise security requirements.
highlights: Led the security architecture workstream for Stellantis Virtual Engineering Workbench, defining requirements, policies and mitigation priorities with customer and AWS stakeholders.
Established governance mechanisms for security metrics and reporting to provide visibility for technical and business leadership.
Built and scaled security enablement programs including Security Champions and Security Guardians initiatives.
Defined scalable partner security mechanisms for Volkswagen Digital Production Platform and supported secure-by-design delivery.

work.name: Swisscom
work.position: Enterprise Architect and IT Clouds Solution Security Architect
work.summary: Provided enterprise and security architecture leadership for Swisscom cloud platforms, with accountability for governance, risk, compliance and data governance across multiple services.
highlights: Directed compliance and assurance activities across internal, contractual and regulatory obligations including ISO27001, ISAE3402/3000 and GDPR.
Built and led a cross-organizational Security Champions community to embed security culture and ownership.
Led threat modeling, audits, penetration testing, vulnerability management and security reporting across platforms.
Contributed to Swisscom Platforms strategic vision for 2025.

work.name: Swisscom
work.position: Team Lead & Product Owner for Health & State Management
work.summary: Built and led the Health and State Management team for Swisscom cloud platforms, combining people leadership with product ownership and delivery governance.
highlights: Managed a team of up to 16 people and owned roadmap definition, prioritization and execution planning.
Defined the mission and scope of Health and State Management as Swisscom cloud portfolio expanded.
Led architectural decisions and service delivery for monitoring, logging and alerting capabilities used across cloud platforms.
Managed stakeholder and vendor relationships supporting critical operational services.

work.name: CFEngine AS
work.summary: Owned product direction for core CFEngine capabilities and led cross-functional delivery initiatives.
highlights: Managed CFEngine language roadmap.
Created and led the CFEngine Design Center project, foundation for the later CFEngine Build service.
Coordinated third-party integration initiatives with major cloud and platform ecosystems.

work.name: Boundless Innovation and Technology
work.position: Cofounder, Head of Research and Training
work.summary: Advised and coordinated teams delivering security and teaching-related products, consulting and services.

work.name: HP Enterprise Services
work.summary: Acted as senior security liaison for enterprise customers, driving security governance and program execution across outsourcing engagements.
highlights: Primary security point of contact for five enterprise customers in Mexico.
Led security-related initiatives across sales, design, implementation, delivery and operations.
Coordinated communication and execution across multidisciplinary technical and business teams.

work.name: National Autonomous University of Mexico (UNAM)
work.position: Founder and lead of Computer Security Area
work.summary: Founded and led UNAM's first dedicated computer security organization, establishing institutional capabilities that evolved into UNAM-CERT.
highlights: Built and managed a team supporting university-wide security services, including incident response, auditing and awareness.
Provided security operations for critical supercomputing infrastructure and Unix environments.
Established and organized early editions of UNAM's International Computer Security Day, which evolved into long-running security events.

projects.name: Executive Security Leadership Highlights
highlights: Lead global CISO governance and ISMS oversight at Avaloq.
Established and scaled security governance workstreams for large multi-stakeholder programs at AWS (Stellantis VEW and Volkswagen DPP).
Directed security architecture, risk management and compliance for Swisscom cloud platforms.
Built and led security communities and cross-functional teams to operationalize security culture and accountability.
Founded UNAM's first dedicated computer security organization, now evolved into UNAM-CERT.

education.summary: Thesis: [Using Internal Sensors for Computer Intrusion Detection](https://zzamboni.org/files/theses/zamboni-phd-thesis.pdf). Advisor: [Eugene H. Spafford](http://spaf.cerias.purdue.edu/)

awards.title: IEEE Security & Privacy Test of Time Award ([IEEE S&P page](https://www.ieee-security.org/TC/SP2020/awards.html), [CERIAS blog post](https://www.cerias.purdue.edu/site/blog/post/a_test_of_time_coast_and_an_award-winning_paper/))
